acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, KHYOD KYANG YIN, DNGOS PO DANG MI 'GAL BA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN YOD PA'I PHYIR TE, SHES BYA DE DE 'DRA'I GZHI MTHUN YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, de chos can, der thal, khyod kyang yin, dngos po dang mi 'gal ba yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te, shes bya de de 'dra'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that a thing which does no work is such that being it is not contradictory to something which is not contradictory to being a working thing.] Suppose you say it's not correct. Consider this same thing. It is so, Because there does exist one thing which is both it, and which is also such that being it is not contradictory to being a working thing; And this is true because "knowable thing" is just such a thing.
